statusVocabulary.pass: Current evidence proves the criterion for the claimed scope.
statusVocabulary.partial: A bounded subset is proven; the remaining scope is named and not advertised.
statusVocabulary.withheld: The capability remains disabled or unavailable by policy until the named gate passes.
statusVocabulary.blocked: Required external or platform evidence cannot be produced in this environment.
